charts.title: HD 22946 d: orbits around TOI-411
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-411's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 22946 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Garai et al. 2023 (2023A&A...674A..44G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GARAI_ET_AL__2023): P 47.42489 d

charts.title: HD 22946 d: its transit
charts.description: HD 22946 d crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (31, 97, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 100990000, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 26-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 26-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
